title: Borel completeness of $R$-modules when $R$ fails the DCC on pp-definable subgroups
summary: We prove that for any countable ring $R$ (not necessarily commutative), if the associated left $R$-module ${}_R R$ has a strictly descending sequence of pp-definable subgroups, then the theory $Th(R^{(ω)})$ of the infinite dimensional direct sum is Borel complete. From this, we conclude that if $R$ is countable and not left perfect, then the theory of $R$-modules is Borel complete, and we give a full characterization of which countable simple rings have Borel complete theories.
